name: Adding products to the cart updates the header cart counter and cart summary
description: Adding the same product twice and a second product once makes the header cart badge show 3 and the cart summary list both products with the right quantities.

planSteps.description: Click Add to Cart on the Aurora Headphones product card
Click Add to Cart on the Aurora Headphones product card again
Click Add to Cart on the Ember Smart Mug product card
Verify the cart counter badge in the page header shows 3
Verify the cart summary panel lists Aurora Headphones with quantity 2 and Ember Smart Mug with quantity 1
